features.title: Days of your choice
features.text: Pick the exact days and hours of the occasion, then share its link.

features.title: Time slots with the mouse
features.text: Drag to show when you're available, several time slots per day, with your finger on a phone.

features.title: In real time
features.text: Everyone sees the others' availabilities appear as they are entered.

features.title: Best times
features.text: A heat map highlights the times when the most people are free.

features.title: Organizations
features.text: Group your members under a logo and invite them all in one click.

features.title: No account
features.text: No password, no tracking: a single essential cookie, and a QR code to switch to your phone.

shots.title: Everyone's calendar
shots.text: Day, Week or Month view: each guest's bar shows the start time, their initials and the end time. Hover over a name to spot them.
shots.alt: Week view: availability bars of each guest, with start time, initials and end time

shots.title: The right time, at a glance
shots.text: The report ranks the best times and places them on a heat map. Dark mode included.
shots.alt: Report: heat map and best times, in dark mode

shots.title: All your occasions
shots.text: Ongoing, upcoming, the ones you manage and the archives, filtered by organization.
shots.alt: List of occasions with organization logos and a crown for the ones you manage

heroTitle: Find the time when everyone is free
heroText: Disponibilités is a group calendar: create an occasion, share its link, and each guest enters the times they're available. Everyone sees the others' availabilities, in real time.
inviteText: Open the link of an occasion someone shared with you: you will be added to it automatically and can then create your own occasions.
inviteDevice: Already using the application on another device? Choose “📱 Link a phone” there and scan the QR code with this one.
mobileText: The editor folds into two rows, morning and afternoon: tap to add a time slot, drag its edges to adjust it. A QR code is all it takes to find your occasions on your phone.
mobileAlt: Time slot editor on a phone: two rows, morning / afternoon
